claim: A validation-only Developer Preview on Linux, macOS and Windows confirmed the packaged optional model download, local English transcription into a reviewable proposal, caption edit/apply through the normal project command, save/reopen, and SRT export.

verification.detail: The exact-source prepare gate passed and all three desktop debug packages were built. The packaged journeys passed model download with confirmation and byte progress, transcription, review/edit/apply, save/reopen and SRT export. CLI and publish jobs were skipped by design.

limitations: These are debug validation-only packages, not installers or a production release.
Android transcription is unsupported; no mobile evidence is claimed.
The optional model download needs network access and is not bundled.
A clean-machine install and the longer import/export journey are separate unverified boundaries.
source: docs/PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md, Current product candidate; docs/PRODUCT.md, VERIFIED IN DESKTOP DEBUG PACKAGES
